notes.title: 1.0 Release Date - Monster Girl Invasion RPG Part 1
notes.content:
Hello Monster Girl Lovers!

[b]1.0 is coming.
[/b]
[h2]Part one of Monster Girl Invasion RPG will finally be leaving early access and hitting 1.0 on July 18th.[/h2]

You can look forward to a multitude of new features and content. New monster girls in the roster, new scenes and more!

In the post-1.0 updates, we'd like to expand the availability of non-defeat h-scenes and ones obtained by other means.

You can find some of the New Additions and Changes below, however this is still yet to be changed as development continues:

[b][h2]New Content:
[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] We'll be adding 3 new monster girls to battle and recruit as well as a scene for the Goldeka Queen and for one of the Maids in the Party inn. That's 5 new h-scenes in total!
[*] Every recruitable character in the game has been given at least 20-30 skills they can learn via level ups. Skill variety has been widely increased.
[*] The story also continues. What will you discover in the new areas and what secrets does the Capital city hold?
[*] The party inn is being expanded with new areas to not only add more flair and more areas for monster girls to live, but also to add new ways to strengthen your party.
[*] There are over 20 new items and equipment that have been added to various points of the game.
[*] More locked chests have been added in various places around the world to make lockpicks more worthwhile.
[/list]
There is also much more yet to be announced, we don't want to reveal everything just yet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/ebd99b512cdafd07e7782230b3f5d95c7637e155.png[/img]
Punished By a Soldier Girl

[b][h2]Upgrades, Changes and Fixes
[/h2][/b]
We've made a huge number of tweaks, fixes and other bits of polish across the board, including but not limited to:

[list]
[*] Lots of story dialogue and other dialogue fixes, tweaks and revisions to keep the story smooth and coherent.
[*] More dialogue added to various places, especially after the player has finished certain events.  For example, after finding the elf-cowgirl hybrid at the lab, if you go back to Nyuuville and speak to the rancher, you can get some special dialogue.
[*] Some cutscenes have been reworked to either have a bit more life so the characters aren't just standing around, or to have character busts display on the screen.
[*] You can now choose the appearance for Monster Girls that have multiple forms, so that your favourite appearance is in the party.
[*] Lots of balance tweaks across the board.
[*] Stat Curves of all Characters have been tweaked significantly to optimise them in a way that make sense for their class.
[*] Many, many bug fixes and other tweaks.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/cd7b53efbbe8cadb96287b9cc549cee38b416926.png[/img]
The Dojo is one of the new Party Inn areas.

[b][h2]Closing Statement:
[/h2][/b]
This is just some of what is to come for the 1.0 release. The changelog will likely be much bigger when the time comes.

[b]However, this is NOT the end for part 1 of the game!
[/b]
[b]Part 1 will still receive free content updates before and after the release of part 2. The first stop is the mysterious snowy area to the north of the world map![/b]

We'll be also going back and adding new content, fixes and tweaks to Part 1 as the world of Monster Girl Invasion RPG develops further when creating Part 2. In the end, it'll all be merged into one massive monster girl filled RPG!

We can' t wait to get it into your hands, we are sure it will be worth the wait!

Much Love,

MGGEDev

notes.title: Update V5g - New Save Import and Export System
notes.content:
Hello Monster girl lovers!

We've updated the game today with a new save import and export system! You can see the shiny new buttons on the title screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/ce9f80513cc2e7f8abddda9942bbe2e552fec2da.png[/img]

This is to make it easier for those who want to transfer their demo saves over to the full game or transfer their saves to other platform versions of the game.

Simply click the export save button and input which save file you would like to export.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/9d01c82cf07be87cdba7db3cc3dec1394d9f0635.png[/img]

The save data will then be copied to your clipboard. Next click the import save button and paste the save data into the box.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/27e013c96313bdf065def1c1f404278ccc40e007.png[/img]

Once you press okay, the save data will be imported and you can load it to continue playing your save.

This is much easier than hunting down the save files on your system and lets you transfer saves between systems and even share them with each other more easily!

This also allows for save data from the newgrounds web demo to be extracted.

Much Love,

MGGEDev

notes.title: Your Votes Are In! Here’s What’s Coming Next!
notes.content:
Hello Monster Girl Lovers!

After our last update in January about the game’s future, I’m back with an exciting new update on what’s coming next!

[b]The Poll Results:
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/13d1a404220fc010206521634673b9c6f6820c4b.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone who voted and shared their thoughts! The community has spoken, and the game will now be split into multiple parts. To reflect this, we’ve already updated the game’s title on storefronts.

Most importantly, I want to sincerely thank each of you for your support, encouragement, and kind messages. This project wouldn’t be possible without you!

[b]What Happens Next?
[/b]
We’ll continue working on the game as normal until we have finished the current storyline in part 1, added a significant amount of polish and also more side content and other fun things.

We want to make sure everything is fully wrapped up.

There will be one more major content update which will conclude part one. This update will include the following:

[list]
[*] 4 new monster girls that are fightable and recruitable
[*] More side content and fleshing out of the world
[*] More learnable Skills for all characters
[*] More Equipment and Items with unique effects
[*] Many bug fixes and optimisations
[/list]

There will be smaller updates and inevitable bug fix patches after this.

[b]When Is The Next Major Update?
[/b]
It’ll hopefully be ready around March or April.

[b]About Pricing
[/b]
I want to make sure the price remains fair. 

[list]
[*] Future parts will not be more expensive than Part 1.
[*] If you own Part 1, you can get other parts with a discounted steam bundle.
[*] Once all parts are complete, we’ll merge them into a Definitive Edition, you’ll get this for free if you own all parts.
[/list]

[b]About Saved Data
[/b]
[list]
[*] Your save data from Part 1 will carry over into Part 2, so you can continue your journey without losing progress.
[*] New players will be able to start fresh with an intro sequence & custom choices to shape their party and inventory.
[/list]

[b]Overall Game Upgrades[/b]

With the way things are being approached for the parts system, any future updates that are made to future parts can be applied to previous parts retroactively.

So for example if we make some sweeping optimisations and changes to the game in part 2, those things will also apply to part 1.

We can even go back and touch up/add things to old areas in part 2 and have those changes reflected into part 1.

This means that we can still maintain and add new things to part 1 as we go along. It isn’t the end of updates for part 1.

Any changes that are made moving forward can benefit all previous parts.

[b]Kickstarter Backers For Part 1
[/b]
All original kickstarter backers for part 1 will get all future parts for free as we do not want to take away from them what was originally promised during the campaign.

[b]Kickstarter For Part 2
[/b]
Once part 1 is completed, there are plans to do a kickstarter for part 2. This is a great opportunity for those that missed the original campaign to get their own custom character and scenes into the game!

This will allow for appropriate funds to be raised to get part 2 fully funded for completion.

Part 1 was a learning experience, and we’ve gained valuable insights into budgeting and development. With Part 2, we can plan ahead more effectively to ensure a smooth development process with confidence.

[b]Contents of Each Part
[/b]
The aim is to have each part contain roughly the same amount of content but never less. All future parts will have around the same amount of characters, side content and story time as part 1 (once completed).

So you can look forward to around 25 new monster girls for each new part!

Once the game and all parts are fully complete, we hope to have over 100 different monster girls. Gotta…Cure them all?

[b]A Thank You & A Look Forward
[/b]
Finally, I want to take a moment to sincerely thank [b]every single player[/b] who has supported this game. Your passion, feedback, and encouragement mean the world to me.

I also want to acknowledge that this wasn’t the original plan, and I deeply appreciate your understanding as we move forward in a way that ensures the game reaches its full potential.

This[b] isn’t[/b] a cash grab decision, just a solo dev who underestimated how much work and funding would be needed to make the game as great as it deserves to be. Thanks to all of you, I won’t give up!

Much love,


MGGEDev

notes.title: Update 5 Now Released | WASD Controls, New Skills, New Monster Girls, Story!
notes.content:
Hello Monster Girl Lovers,

We're back with the first major update of 2024!

This update contains 3 new monster girls, a bunch of new skills and a new way to obtain and expand the skills for your party members via improv weapons!

The game finally supports modern WASD controls!

We've also fixed an extensive amount of bugs and issues reported to us over the past months.

[b]Changelog:
[/b]
[b]New Content:
[/b]
[list]
[*] The Game Now Supports WASD Movement!
[*] Added 3 New Monster Girls!
[*] Added a new monster girl the "Dark Doppelganger" She has one H-Scene and can be recruited. She is a special variant of doppelganger.
[*] Added a new monster girl the "Corpse Bride" She has one H-Scene and can be recruited. You'll find her in the mansion!
[*] Added a new monster girl the "Zombie Girl" She has one H-Scene and can be recruited. Don't believe her appearance!
[*] Added more to the main story, it continues upon entering the Spooky Mansion!
[*] Monster recruitment is now (hopefully) working in the Cheat Room!
[*] Added around 50 new skills and some new states, we've added many more skills focused on pleasure based attacks as well as fleshing out existing characters/enemies so that they have more versatility and usefulness.
[*] Added around 40 new skill animations to go with some of the new skills.
[*] Added a whole bunch of new items and pieces of equipment, 55 to be exact! Some have special features as described below!
[*] Improvised Weapons now each have a unique skill attached to them that can only be used when the weapon is equipped. Using the AP system, you can master the skill by using the weapon in battle and earning enough AP points. Once you've mastered the skill, you can use it without having the weapon equipped!
[*] Added some more little secrets and bits of flavour around the world.
[*] Added some more locked chests in some locations.
[/list]


[b]Fixes and Tweaks:
[/b]
[list]
[*] The Goldeka Card Beasts tournament has been overhauled and fixed. Please try to break it!
[*] Fixed issue of some party members not swapping correctly when recruiting new monster girls with a full party.
[*] Fixed Hellhound triggering Dragon Girl temptation event and Dryad Game Over (Somehow).
[*] Fixed some more collision issues in Goldeka.
[*] Fixed  typos in Second Campsite and Lass Request scene.
[*] Fixed Lamia fight in pyramid being triggerable multiple times.
[*] Fixed guard that replaces thrall by the whipping post in Goldeka being invisible.
[*] Using steal no longer removes the gold from enemies drop pool,  it is now extra bonus gold.
[*] Increased the chance to steal items with steal skill.
[*] Weakness and Resistance text now properly appears during battles when using attacks based on enemy strengths/weaknesses.
[*] Added the Mansion to the Telestone menu.
[*] Added a lever to the Pyramid Puzzle that resets the statues to prevent players getting stuck.
[*] Improved Controller Integration
[*] Improved performance in some areas, especially achievement triggers and other background events.
[*] Improved behaviour of boat to stop players getting stranded after teleporting or loading saved games, it will now reset either to its original position or docking locations specified on the islands depending on where you are when you leave locations. It is a bit of a dirty fix but it'll stop frustrating situations for now until we can implement a better solution.
[*] Goldeka port can now be re-entered from the boat dock if you decide to dock there or just want to re-enter the city.
[*] Added Goldeka Port to the teleport menu for faster access to the boat spawn location.
[*] More Fixes to TeleStones being able to be used during special scenes which would cause them to break.
[*] Escape Scrolls have been adjusted and fixed in many places, they should work as intended in all dungeon locations now.
[*] Game now correctly shows an icon on the task bar and window.
[/list]




[b]Current Known Issues to be fixed in follow up updates:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Story Skips are still disabled as they are not functioning correctly,  after much work, we've made the decision to push the update without this function for the time being. It is far too buggy for us to push out just yet. There is a lot that we need to change in the back end in order to get it working more smoothly. Sorry for the inconvenience.
[*] Actions in the Cheat Room may still cause bugs or strange things to happen during the story. (having certain characters before you are supposed to and etc.) We'll continue to patch it when issues are discovered.
[*] For the time being, we have disabled the ability to recruit boss characters in the cheat room to avoid it causing conflicts during the story, once we've fixed some of the backend systems we'll be able to enable this function.
[*] Some story dialogue CGs are missing flavour, more flavour text and etc will come in further updates. Especially we will be going back and touching up some cutscenes and dialogue to make them a bit more impactful.
[/list]


[b]Coming Next:
[/b]
[list]
[*] A Complete Graphical Overhaul to make the game look more unique.
[*] More monster girls to fit the new areas. Coming next are some wild monster girls for the northern world map area, some Succubi and more!
[*] Adding a bunch of new H-Scene sound effects to help set the mood. (they are already almost ready but need some tweaks).
[*] More Main Story
[*] More Side Content
[/list]


We hope you enjoy! 

More content is coming as well as more monster girls, the game isn't over yet!

If you find any bugs or have any issues, don't hesitate to post in the forums or get in touch with us, it helps us squash them as they are discovered.

Happy Hunting! 

 MGGEDev

notes.title: New Year Progress Report - Update 5 Inbound!
notes.content:
Hello Monster Girl Lovers!

We're here with our first devlog of the year, sorry for the wait. We hope you all had a wonderful new year!

We'll be adding so much to the game in Update 5, we're so excited to get it done and release it to you all. Whilst we did take a break over the holidays to visit family, we've been tapping away relentlessly so that we can get this next update done. 

We were originally hoping to get it out by the new year but things are taking a bit longer than expected in certain areas. We also decided to change one of the original planned characters, which is currently being re-designed.

We'll be adding 3 new monster girls in Update 5! 

Will you be able to resist them all?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/433b2221e001891b6a175d336236b8df0e69a120.png[/img]

The main story will be continued from the Spooky Mansion, what secrets does it hold? What kind of monsters are lurking in the dark halls?

We have also continued work on the Cheat Room, Story Skips and monster recruitment should be (hopefully) fully functional upon release of Update 5!

With the extra time given to us whilst the new characters are being designed, we have also expanded other parts of the update beyond the original scope!

There has been a lot of feedback relating to lack of skills for certain characters and some players have specifically requested more skills focused on dealing "pleasure" type damage. We're pleased to announce we'll be adding 50+ new skills to the game with update 5! Many of them will be pleasure focused but we're adding a wide range of types. These skills will also come with a huge variety of newly added animations!

With these new skills will also come some new states to go with them, such as the "mounted" state, when a monster girl has jumped on top of you in an attempt to use your body. If you don't escape in time, it'll turn into a "sex" state and she'll begin to drain your life force with her sexual attacks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/35c705e325b04bd4c7a53ce152435c4a77f2d157.png[/img]

We're also expanding upon improvised weapons. Until now, improvised weapons were simply cool or universal weapons that could be used by anyone. Now, with our new system, all improvised weapons will come with a unique skill attached to them. These skills can only be used when the weapon is equipped.  However,  with every battle you win, you'll earn AP points from your enemies. Using the AP points system, you can master the skill by using the weapon in battle and earning enough AP points. Once you've mastered the skill, you can use it without having the weapon equipped!

You'll see the available skill and the AP requirement to master it in the equipment window when you highlight the weapon.

On the back of this new AP system, we're adding a huge amount of new weapons, equipment and also other useful items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/9ad8d6768b4465b6bcde8561b7e58571fdf99838.png[/img]

There is also a lot of work going into sound effects for the H-Scenes. notes.title: Monster Girl Invasion RPG - First Alpha Release Now Live!
notes.content:
The time has finally arrived!
It has been a long time coming and we are incredibly nervous to finally be pushing the big button...But...

The first Early Access Alpha version of Monster Girl Invasion RPG is now released!

[u][b]State of the Game:[/b][/u]
The game is effectively still an alpha and does not fully represent our vision for the final version, however we hope it is in a state that is both playable and enjoyable for players!

If you want to play a longer, more fleshed out and polished game, it might be worth waiting for at least a couple of more chapters to be added in updates.

There is at the very least a good couple of hours of gameplay for players who want to collect all current monster girls and view all their scenes. The story is slightly shorter if you simply focus on finishing the first chapter.

We recommend collecting all monster girls in preparation for the new story, quest and location additions to come!

More monster girls and content are coming very soon!

It has been important for us to get something playable into the hands of those that have already supported us so much to reach this point. 
We appreciate all of your support and wanted to prove that we are making something that is worthy of supporting.

We hope this will serve as an example of what more is to come when we eventually reach our 1.0 vision of this game and our Monster Girl world!

Things will very likely be quite different later on in the development of the game, things will be reworked, redone and tweaked. Most importantly, things will be much more fleshed out, content rich and polished!

[u][b]This version of the game currently includes the following features:[/b][/u]

- 9 Monster girls + 1 Human Girl with 1 H-Scene Each (more monsters being worked on!)
- Recruitable monster girls with unique abilities, collect them all!
- Inn hub where player can manage their party and interact with recruited monster girls
- Affection system to get H-Scenes without needing to suffer from game over
- First Chapter of the story is written and implemented
- Various locations to explore and quests to complete
- A variety of items and equipment (more to be added soon, we need more!)
- Many other features!
- Maybe some sneaky bugs yet to be discovered (please let us know if you find any!)

[u][b]Ending Note:[/b][/u]

It has been a long and difficult journey hand crafting this adventure from scratch but it has also been a pleasure to work on it! We really hope that players will be able to enjoy what we have created so far.
We hope this will serve as a decent taster for you to look forward to what comes next for the game, plenty more content, the rest of the story and game upgrades are heavily underway!
Any constructive feedback is welcomed, please reach out to us via your preferred channel, be it via the steam forums, discord or simply sending us a private message or email.
We'll try our best to take all valid feedback into consideration when adjusting and creating the rest of the game.

Thank you again and we hope you enjoy our game,

Kind Regards,

MGGEDev

Hello Everyone and happy Monday! 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mggedev/monster-girl-invasion-rpg/]Our kickstarter campaign has been successful![/url]
Sorry it took a little while for a celebratory post, we hope this post will outline everything which lies ahead.  We've also included some development screenshots to view whilst you read.

[h1]First Of all:[/h1]
Before we begin, thank you to each and every one of you that have made a pledge to our project or gone on to pre-order elsewhere. You have no idea how happy we are to receive your support and the interest that you have shown for our game. Thank you to those that stopped by to take a look as well! 

Thanks to you, this game which was only an idea at first, is now turning into a reality.

We have seen the stats and it seems we have managed to reach our original funding goal and even beyond, we never expected such a great response!

Due to their sickness, the monster girls have become extremely aggressive!

The initial early-access release is still on schedule to be ready as planned in early March. Outside of some kind of freak emergency, a playable build should be in your hands by then!

So far we have 10 Monster Girls implemented as we originally planned for in the first build. Hopefully we can exceed this number before the initial release, but it goes without saying that many more will be added in updates over time.

The initial release may not fully reflect the finished game, but we are extremely eager to show off what we have made so far and making every effort to provide a solid first experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/47edc905e94ab3fcd0d365d5c614005e71777386.png[/img]
What secrets of the the Holy Shrines around the world will you uncover?

[h1]Post-Release Update Plans:[/h1]
We are aiming to release the first chapter of the main story to start with as a minimum. This will allow for a good stopping point to continue when the next chapter gets added and prevent things from getting too disjointed for those that want to play along as the game is developed. 

It is also very important to us that we release enough content for you to have fun with so that things aren't too short.

Between major updates, such as a new chapter being added, tweaks, fixes and new content (such as new monster girls or challenges) will also be added to existing areas. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/26e533a0cc03b6a2b9acca9c8c7bc8073e3f43cf.png[/img]
Build and mix your ideal party at the mysterious inn. Hang out with your allies and maybe more!

All copies of the game will be fulfilled via Itch.io which also comes with a claimable steam key when you add it to your account. We feel this is the most ideal way to distribute but if there are any issues with this method for any of you, please let us know!

[b]Name in Credits/In-Game[/b]

Name in the Credits rewards and Tombstone Rewards will be added as soon as we have heard back from you as to what name you want us to add. 

[b]CG Archive Access[/b]

We will add you to our google drive archive containing all current CGs. (This method makes it much easier for us to update it on the fly with newly made content). Again, please let us know if you are not okay with this and we can look into alternatives.

[b]Help Design a Monster Girl Reward[/b]

Feel free to answer the survey with all the details of what concept you would like to go forward with. The easiest way for us to coordinate it would be over something like discord or through messages. We may need to discuss a little bit or make a few tweaks to make sure your monster girl concept will fit into the game but we'll try to figure it out as best we can. Once we have your overall concept or idea of your favourite monster girl we will let our artists do their amazing thing to bring her to life based on your description and then work on fitting her into the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/f0c36c3ccc7fc591912343d5059b7883f8361819.png[/img]
Help may come from all kinds of strange places.

If there is anything we haven't covered or if you would like to know more, please don't hesitate to send us a message. We're always happy to talk!

Kind regards and signing off for now,

Work continues on the game and our artists are creating amazing work for us at a great pace.

We have been working on implementing one of our latest monster girls "Arogane" the spider queen. Keep an eye out for her in creepy caves or you may end up being her next prisoner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/9944779ac464bba631d5778f8ee57d97156ec198.png[/img]

Maps are still heavily WIP but we have a good prototype basis of how we want the first continent and the surrounding areas to look. The next step after getting the first handful of monster girls implemented solidly, will be adding the feature to recruit them!

You can recruit one monster girl of each type, once recruited they will join your party as a unique character with their own personality and skills. Some recruitable bosses will serve as  main characters for story purposes but you can happily go through the game using your favourite monster girls of any combination and achieve the same experience.

_____

[h1]Devlog from 5th December 2021[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603174/4dc5f44623249f5d4b84ea6d9ad5bb74eccebf48.png[/img]

As our artists complete more art and character designs for us, we will work on implementing these characters and their corresponding traits/skills.

The first task is for us to make the battle system work the way we want it to. Monster girls need to have the ability to tease and tempt the hero in different ways as well as attack him. Sometimes they may even interrupt the battle to make a sexual offer. Be warned that this will definitely end in your demise, so don't get too tempted by them! ;)

When losing a battle, who gets to violate him will depend on which monster gets the killing blow. We have it working in quite a wonky way right now, so it doesn't always seem accurate. We will need to refine it more before being fully satisfied with it.

Eventually we want to have the player be able to recruit monster girls they have fought with. They will join your party as a unique character, with their own personality, dialogue and skills. We hope that players will be able to mix and match them to suit their play style and also overcome challenges.

___


If you read this far, thank you so much for reading!
We will post updates to steam more regularly from now on, we can't wait to show off more of the game to you!
